posture: candidates only — NO remote writes, edits, checkpoints, deploys, publishes, or entity ops were performed

defects.defect: deleteModuleTemplate pre-read used `.get(id).catch(() => null)` — every transient get failure (500/429/timeout) resolved to `current === null` and minted a FALSE delete success (`return true`), so the dialog dropped a live template row.
defects.fix: Explicit try/catch around the pre-read; canonical not-found detection (status 404 OR 'not found'/'does not exist' across message + response.data.message/error + data.message/error) resolves `true` (already gone); every other error rethrows. Fetched record must be a real non-array object with `current.id === id` or the delete aborts with an error. Delete still routes through the anchored CAS helper deleteEntityIfUnchanged.
defects.harness: 404-family resolves already-gone with no deleteMany; 500/TypeError/403/429 propagate; null/array/wrong-id/scalar fetched records abort; verified record issues exactly one {id, updated_date}-anchored deleteMany via the real helper; blank id rejected.

defects.defect: Load effect ran `listModuleTemplates(...).then(setTemplates)` with no catch — a load rejection both leaked an unhandled rejection and left `templates` empty, rendering a fake 'no templates' list.
defects.fix: Added loading / loadFailed / error state, seq-guarded loadRows() with mountedRef + loadSeqRef (stale-response safe), catch marks loadFailed and surfaces the message, and a Retry affordance re-runs the load. Fake-empty is impossible: rows only render after a resolved load.
defects.harness: Mount with rejecting loader renders failure copy + Retry (not fake empty); clicking Retry with a now-resolving loader recovers to the real list.

defects.defect: save() had try/finally but NO catch — a save rejection propagated as an unhandled rejection with busy reset but no visible error state.
defects.fix: catch surfaces `e.message || 'Template could not be saved.'` inline while the dialog stays open; success path unchanged (idempotent attempt key, name reset, onClose). Compatibility: onApply/onClose contract for the 8 out-of-scope caller pages is preserved — dialog closes after a non-throwing save regardless of any callback return value.
defects.harness: Rejecting save surfaces inline error, dialog stays open, busy resets. Successful save closes and service receives moduleKey + idempotency data. Separate case: throwing onApply surfaces error + stays open; success closes even when onApply returns undefined (the actual remote caller contract).

defects.defect: Row delete had `catch {}` — a silent no-op comment admitted the row 'stays in the list' but the failure was invisible, AND combined with R-1 a transient pre-read error could mint false success and drop the row.
defects.fix: catch surfaces `e.message || 'Template could not be deleted.'` in the dialog error region; the row is filtered only after deleteModuleTemplate resolves (which now only happens on verified delete or genuine not-found).
defects.harness: Transient PRE-READ 500 -> row kept + error shown; 404 -> row removed; CAS delete rejection -> row kept + error shown.

defects.defect: removeClipboardItem used `.get(id).catch(() => null)` then `if (!current) return` — every transient get failure silently returned success, and the modal filtered the row out of the UI regardless (stale-remove).
defects.fix: Service: explicit try/catch; canonical not-found resolves (already gone); transient errors rethrow. Modal: removal wrapped in try/catch with busyId guard + setError; the row is filtered ONLY after removeClipboardItem resolves; failure keeps the row and shows the error.
defects.harness: Service: 500/429/TypeError propagate; 404 family + resolved-null return without delete; verified record -> anchored deleteMany. Modal: transient failure keeps the row + surfaces error; confirmed removal drops the row.

defects.defect: handlePermanentDelete ran the EstimateAcceptance warning read with `.catch(() => [])` — a transient failure resolved to 'no acceptances' and skipped the only warning before an IRREVERSIBLE permanent delete.
defects.fix: try/catch fails CLOSED: on rejection the handler setTrashError('Linked records could not be verified, so the estimate was not permanently deleted. Try again.' (+ err detail)) and returns BEFORE window.confirm/delete.
defects.harness: Rejecting filter read -> confirm never shown, no delete attempted, block reason rendered. Verified acceptances -> confirm warning names 'N recorded customer acceptances' and delete proceeds on confirm.

defects.defect: Quick-trash guard called getOpenEstimateRevision, whose `.catch(() => null)` swallows read errors — a transient failure let an estimate with an open revision be trashed.
defects.fix: Replaced with an inline strict read: identical bounded loadAllEntityRows call (entity EstimateRevision, query {estimate_id, revision_status:'open'}, sort '-revision_number', limit 50, label 'Open estimate revision') minus the swallow — rejection propagates to the handler's existing catch which setTrashError + returns (fail closed). getOpenEstimateRevision itself is unchanged (out-of-scope file; its null-on-error posture is correct for its advisory caller ensureEstimateLifecycleRevision); the dead import was removed.
defects.harness: Rejecting strict read -> confirm never shown, estimate not trashed, block reason rendered, read args verified identical to the helper's. Open revision present -> blocks with message before confirm. Verified-empty -> confirm -> soft delete proceeds.

defects.defect: persistGroupOrder ran `updateMany({id},{sort_order}).catch(() => null)` per moved group — rejections AND CAS no-matches (updated:0) were swallowed, so the drag order LOOKED applied while it silently reverted on reload.
defects.fix: Each write is anchored on the loaded updated_date when known and the result is verified (`result.updated === 1`); rejections and non-1 counts collect into failures[]. On any failure the prior order is restored, an alert names the failed groups, and the product is re-read to resync. Signature changed to persistGroupOrder(nextGroups, previousGroups).
defects.harness: Write rejection -> visual order reverts + alert + product re-read. result.updated=0 -> counted as failure, order reverts. Success -> order applies, writes anchored on loaded updated_date, no alert.

defects.defect: toggleOpen did `.get().catch(() => null)` for the pre-read (transient -> current null -> early return while the optimistic toggle stayed flipped, diverging from persisted is_collapsed) and `.catch(() => null)` on the CAS write (failure -> UI showed a collapse state the record does not hold).
defects.fix: Pre-read and write are separately wrapped: any rejection reverts setOpen(!next) and alerts 'Part Group collapsed state could not be saved.' (+ error detail). Success still refreshes groupVersionRef from the verified write result.
defects.harness: Pre-read 500 -> open reverts + alert. CAS write rejection -> open reverts + alert. Success -> real {$set:{is_collapsed}} write anchored on loaded updated_date, verified via post-save re-read, no alert.

defects.defect: Exported deleteOwnedSection ran `delete(project_id).catch(() => null)` — every failure swallowed. Decision: FIXED rather than removed — the export is part of the documented module-shared API (has jsdoc, sits next to used exports), zero callers at HEAD is noted in a code comment, and a corrected implementation can never silently fail.
defects.fix: try/catch: canonical not-found resolves true; transient errors rethrow. Non-owned/unknown-module/missing-project inputs return false (explicit no-op) instead of undefined; verified delete resolves true.
defects.harness: 500/429/TypeError/403 propagate; 404 resolves true; resolved delete resolves true; non-owned/unknown-module/missing-project return false without touching the entity.
